name: cdr
description: CDR: a provider-agnostic AI coding harness with a terminal workspace, a web app, and a native desktop app.
author: Rafael Birkmann

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/cli packages/react && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm build:packages && pnpm bundle:harness && pnpm --filter desktop app:dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm bundle:harness && pnpm --filter desktop app:build
scripts.release:cli: pnpm build && pnpm bundle:harness && node scripts/package-cli.mjs
